title: HCERT library contract
summary: The API contract both HCERT libraries implement: the WIT package (api/wit/, who:smart-trust) and the CBOR wire format in CDDL (api/cddl/). One node per .wit or .cddl file; each cites the requirements it carries as [STT-…] tags in its comments.
validatorNotApplicable: its nodes are WIT and CDDL source, not JSON a Zod schema could parse. WIT is parsed by jco in gen-api-types and by wit2kotlin (--check fails on a stale Kotlin skeleton); CDDL is checked against the PR 129 vector by check-models.

avatar.reads: lines of an interface with an arrow out: a contract other code implements

rationale: A kind of its own because the contract is what the requirements constrain and the libraries realize: a requirement's [STT-…] tag in a WIT doc comment is the edge from contract to requirement, and the Kotlin skeleton and TypeScript view are derived from these files.
